_metadata.description: Ranking that explains itself from the computation that produced it.

requirements.title: Explanations are derived, never narrated after the fact
requirements.description: The explanation for a recommendation is produced from the same computation that produced the ranking, and its stated contributions reconstruct the score. No explanation is generated by a separate component that infers a plausible rationale, because such an explanation can be confidently wrong.

validation.notes: Reported contributions reconstruct the score within tolerance

requirements.title: Exploitation and exploration are distinguishable
requirements.description: Every recommendation states whether it was chosen because the model expects it to be liked or because the model is uncertain and wants to learn. The listener can always tell which is happening.

validation.notes: Each result carries an exploit/explore attribution consistent with the policy

requirements.title: Every attribute in an explanation is actionable
requirements.description: Any attribute named in an explanation can be acted on directly from that explanation — asked for more of, less of, or excluded — so understanding and steering are the same gesture.

validation.notes: Each named attribute exposes reinforce, suppress, and exclude controls
